items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Frank Sebastian still running it when it was the Casa Mañana? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: So all kind of things happened on the road. We came out here and stayed eight weeks in the Casa Mañana. It used to be the Cotton Club, in Culver City.
